repair_summary: Added low-speed mixing guidance from King Arthur Baking, clarified FDA-backed 71°C center safety target and cooling limits, and synchronized the four locale notes.

issues.description: 四語稿已同步補充中低速拌合、逐顆加入雞蛋及達溫即停烤的操作。中心 71°C 保留為 FDA 蛋料理 160°F 指引的食安檢查點；King Arthur Baking 的 165–170°F 讀值量在距蛋糕邊緣約 2.5 公分處，配方、模具與測量位置不同，不能直接代換本稿中心讀值。此 6 吋水浴配方的實際烘烤時間、冷卻後凝固程度、切片份量與封面圖一致性尚待真人試作核實，未宣稱已試作。
issues.suggested_fix: 請依四語流程以列出器具試作，記錄實際烘烤與冷卻時間、冷藏後凝固與切片表現，確認中心溫度計讀值及封面圖和成品是否相符，再修訂未能重現的細節。

mechanical_review.disposition: Reviewed against the complete ingredient list and steps. All listed crust and filling ingredients are represented in the steps; the 71°C endpoint follows FDA consumer guidance for egg dishes, while recipe-specific bake and chilled-set behavior remain unverified.
